name: Global Infrastructure Reporting and Analysis: one morning read that declares whether anything needs Andrew, across every Opal property (third-member naming at Andrew; PRD s.6), with instrument state separable from world state and every number carrying its coverage.
description: Replace a miscalibrated daily infrastructure report with one whose rows can be trusted. Twelve ratified outcomes: a declarative morning verdict; a vocabulary that separates 'nobody looked' from 'we looked and here is how bad'; per-row deltas; property+owner attribution; whether an alert would reach a human before an incident tests it; broken-vs-retired on consumer evidence rather than age; retirement on the record; cost movement that matters; one compute record spanning EC2 and ECS; counts that carry their denominators; what we publish that nothing watches; and, on an anomaly, the connected resources plus an analysis bounded by C-AI. Andrew-direct commissioning 2026-09-09: 'it has been miscalibrated for a long time and it's time that we fixed that.'

(6) ADDED AT ROUND 3 PREP BY L6 RULING (1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z msg 20822, row NFRA_REPORT-Z-S12 @73ffb25e28, dispositioning W1-S5 DISMISSED_WITH_REASON as an outside remedy under spine 2.4): EVERY ROUND-3 WORKER FACE MUST CARRY the instruction that any census or absence claim is run from the MAIN ajb_workspace checkout, NEVER from the worker's own linked worktree, and that a comp-find/comp-read/comp-which ZERO obtained inside a worktree is NOT evidence of absence. The comp-rail resolves its corpus from the TOOL SCRIPT'S own on-disk location (~/bin/comp-find:16 hardcodes the main-tree path; _comprail.repo_root() runs with cwd=_HERE), so rule 14b's mandated worktree and rule 21's default instrument combine into a silent GRAIN mismatch that prints a MEASURED denominator over the wrong tree. The hazard is LIVE AT HEAD and UNOWNED -- nothing is fixed, and this worker-face clause is the only thing protecting this project from it.
